messages.subject: Timeout waiting for check_container_alive when Deploying Shiny App
parts:
Hello,

I have been trying to deploy my Shiny app to shinyapps.io and I have been getting a timeout error. Here is what is in my console along with my session information. I only found one question similar to this: https://support.rstudio.com/hc/en-us/community/posts/206237548-App-upload-timeout-error-for-leaflet. Based on this information, I tried deploying it later on in the day and the following day and it didn't work. If anyone could help me with this matter, it would be much appreciated!

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Timeout waiting for check_container_alive when Deploying Shiny App
parts: It appears you are attempting to deploy a static site to shinyapps.io, which it turns out we don't support.

On Monday, July 31, 2017 at 9:31:48 AM UTC-4, Dorris Scott wrote:
Hello,

I have been trying to deploy my Shiny app to shinyapps.io and I have been getting a timeout error. Here is what is in my console along with my session information. I only found one question similar to this: https://support.rstudio.com/hc/en-us/community/posts/206237548-App-upload-timeout-error-for-leaflet. Based on this information, I tried deploying it later on in the day and the following day and it didn't work. If anyone could help me with this matter, it would be much appreciated!
